controls.name: machinery-disabled arm
controls.spec: Same 500 elaboration episodes and 500 recall probes with the partition/tagging machinery disabled (belief store open).
controls.pass_criterion: MUST leak constructed content into factual recall (>=1 probe shows a >=16-byte constructed substring). If the control does not leak, the probes are dead and the leg is INVALID.

controls.name: naive-caller control
controls.spec: An unfiltered caller (no guard checks, no tag awareness) issues reads against the store.
controls.pass_criterion: The naive caller must be STRUCTURALLY unable to observe constructed content (addressing separation, not caller discipline). If it can, the design is KILLED.
